title: Harbison Protection Contracts Terms: When Coverage Starts and Ends
content:
**Condition 1. Contracts tied to a Harbison installation.** A contract issued with the purchase channel "with installation" or "post-installation window" starts coverage on the installation's installed date, so its term runs from the day the equipment was started up even when it was bought later. It activates on issue once any contract price billed on the contract is paid.

**Condition 2. Price paid in full.** A purchased contract is activated only after its contract price has been paid in full. This is read from the contract's billing history and its balance.

**Condition 3. Aftermarket waiting period.** An aftermarket contract is activated only once the tier's aftermarket waiting period, in calendar days, has passed since the contract was purchased. Waiting-period days are counted as calendar days with the purchase date as day 0, and coverage starts on the day after the last waiting day. An aftermarket contract's coverage start is that day, and a failure diagnosed before it is never covered.

**Condition 4. Coverage end.** The coverage end is the day before the same calendar date that lies the tier's labor coverage years after the coverage start.

**Condition 5. Contracts issued by transfer.** A contract issued by transfer activates on issue with the seller's coverage start and coverage end unchanged.

**Condition 6. Claim benefit granted at activation.** Activation grants the claim benefit: the tier's lifetime claim benefit, with reason "activation". The former clause granting, on a transfer, the seller's remaining claim benefit with reason "transfer carryover" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the benefit carried to a buyer.

**Worked dates (hypothetical).**

| Situation | Dates |
|---|---|
| Aftermarket purchase on 1 April 2026, 30-day waiting period | day 0 is 1 April; day 30, the last waiting day, is 1 May; coverage starts 2 May 2026. A failure diagnosed on 1 May 2026 is never covered; one diagnosed on 2 May 2026 falls on the first covered day. |
| Coverage start 15 June 2021, 5 labor coverage years | the same calendar date five years on is 15 June 2026; the coverage end is 14 June 2026 |
| Installation completed 3 August 2025, contract bought after installation on 20 January 2026 | coverage start is 3 August 2025, the installed date |

superseded_clauses: or, on a transfer, the seller's claim_limit_remaining with reason transfer_carryover
